title: Optimal stability of regularized spectral differentiation in Sobolev spaces
summary: We study the problem of stable spectral differentiation of functions in Sobolev spaces from noisy data. We introduce a class of admissible Fourier multipliers under simple and directly verifiable conditions and show that the corresponding regularized differentiation operators achieve minimax optimal stability rates. The results extend the previous $L^2$ based results to Sobolev spaces $H^{s,p}(\mathbb{R}^n)$, $1<p<\infty$.
